description: Explain an IEEE 754 binary32 or binary64 value. Pass bits as hex, or a decimal or fraction, which is rounded ties-to-even. Returns the class, sign, unbiased exponent, fraction bits, and the exact value. Negative zero stays negative. The word nan is the quiet NaN; snan is the signaling NaN with payload 1. The top fraction bit is the quiet bit. Returns JSON with: width, bits, kind, sign, exponent, hidden, significand, quiet. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/float-bits
name: float_bits
title: Float Bits
